title: Markdown Document Structural Formatting and Unified Unordered List Hygiene

claims.assertion: Markdown headings must be separated from preceding and following lists or paragraphs by exactly one blank line to satisfy MD022 and MD032.
claims.evidence: Commit 6e43ba7 added blank lines below all ### domain headings in CONTEXT-MAP.md, clearing MD022 and MD032 warnings.

claims.assertion: Unordered list items across top-level and nested hierarchies must use a uniform bullet marker (dash '-') rather than mixing asterisks and dashes to prevent MD004 style conflicts.
claims.evidence: Commit 6e43ba7 unified all list markers to '-' in CONTEXT-MAP.md, resolving all MD004 warnings.
